name: What is the typical process for split siding repair?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for split siding repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process generally involves assessing the damage to determine the extent and cause of the split. For minor splits, a high-quality sealant or epoxy might be used. For larger or more significant splits, the damaged section of siding is carefully removed. A new piece of siding, matched to the existing material and color, is then cut to size and installed. Proper flashing and sealing are crucial to prevent future moisture intrusion.
acceptedAnswer.description: Split siding repair involves assessing damage, then either sealing minor splits or carefully replacing larger damaged sections with new, matched material.
